Syncs Monica passwords, standalone 2FA, Steam accounts and tokens, passkeys, notes, wallet items, folders, history, trash and attachments. Non-exportable passkeys retain their credential information and need setup on the receiving device. Bitwarden and KeePass accounts use their own sync.
Receive only sends no local vault contents; send only saves no remote contents. Both devices determine the transfer direction.
Both devices only send, or both only receive. Use bidirectional sync on one device or choose opposite directions.
The other device cannot honor one-way sync. Update both devices or use bidirectional sync.
